documents.title: P1 incident response
documents.text: For North Logistics, P1 incidents receive an initial response within 15 minutes. The incident owner provides updates every 60 minutes until recovery.

documents.title: Refund review policy
documents.text: Refunds and subscription cancellations require finance review. Support may prepare a draft and collect the invoice reference, but cannot execute a refund or cancel an account.

documents.title: Account access
documents.text: Customers can request a password reset using the Forgot password link on the sign-in page. Support must never request or disclose a password.

documents.title: South Manufacturing support
documents.text: For South Manufacturing, P1 incidents receive an initial response within 30 minutes. The incident owner provides updates every 120 minutes until recovery.
